mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates, but SPX posts negative 60-day returns more than 40% of the time in the following 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO prints two sub-50 readings, but SPX still rises more than 60% of days over the next 20 trading sessions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in initial jobless claims (4-week moving average) signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next month.
failure_condition: 4-week PAYEMS avg jumps 10%+ above year-ago, but SPX still gains more than 55% of days over next 20.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% y-o-y for 3 consecutive months, it signals building inflationary pressures that will prompt the Fed to tighten policy and depress S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y exceeds 3% for 3 months, but SPX still rises more than 55% of days over next 60.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise more than 10% y-o-y while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a healthy consumer backdrop that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y > 10% and UNRATE < 5%, but SPX posts negative 20-day returns more than 40% of the time in the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) rises above 55 while the Fed funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, it signals an accommodative policy backdrop that will boost industrial activity and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and FEDFUNDS < 3%, but SPX posts negative 60-day returns more than 40% of the time in the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4% while average hourly earnings (not in catalog) accelerate more than 3% y-o-y, it signals a tight labor market that will boost consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next month.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and AHE > 3% y-o-y, but SPX still falls more than 45% of days over next 20.

mechanism_narrative: When the 10-year Treasury yield (not in catalog) rises more than 50 basis points in a month while the Fed funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a tightening of financial conditions that will depress S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: 10-year yield rises > 50bps in 1 month and FEDFUNDS > 4%
failure_condition: 10-year yield rises 50+ bps in a month and FEDFUNDS > 4%, but SPX still gains more than 55% of days over next 60.
